targetTest: 59-07: apply payload railMotions acceptance (MOTN-01/MOTN-12) > lands one motion record in the parent document and moves the canonical revision
expected: The apply payload accepts an optional railMotions collection, the bridge forwards it with preserve-when-absent semantics, and one record lands in the parent document's rotoPhysical.railMotions while moving the canonical per-track revision
actual: The payload validator rejects the railMotions member as an unknown key (unknown-keys), so the bridge returns ok:false and the parent document keeps the frozen empty collection; the types module also exposes no isPhysicPaintRotoRailMotionCollection guard
semanticAssessment: The named target testcase executed in this run and failed on its planned assertion (result.ok === false because the closed allowlist rejects the railMotions key), not on a build, import, collection or fixture fault. 9 tests collected, 5 pass / 4 fail; every failure is planned missing behavior: the payload member, its validator clause, the bridge staging carry and the thin collection guard do not exist yet. The fifth test (store transactionality identity) fails on a test-side over-strict reference assertion against a getter that mints a fresh array; it will be expressed as deep equality.
